summary: Clarified preview source for docs text batch JSON parse failures: R4/T-4 use the normalized agent response passed to parseBatchJsonResponse, while R3 keeps agent-level stdout preview for subprocess failures.

items.title: Docs text preview source conflicts with available data path
items.rationale: Updated spec language so docs text parse errors preview the normalized agent response available in src/docs/commands/text.js, not raw subprocess stdout owned by src/lib/agent.js.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[3].desc and acceptance_criteria[3] now name the normalized agent response passed to parseBatchJsonResponse.
